subject: Fix ax66_makatau HTIF alias-region bug in vsim_andesim (TDD)
description:
Root cause confirmed (not the old L2C theory): ax66_makatau's guest DRAM is based at 0x800000000 (an "alias" window onto the same RAM), but SimControl::dispatch() (src/platform/sim_control.hpp) and guest_va_to_host() (src/htif/sys_call.hpp) in vsim_andesim always subtracted the primary region's base (0x0), never checking alias_region. Confirmed via vendor datasheet (this mechanism isn't vendor IP) and direct source reading.

RED: wrote src/tests/platform/sim_control.test.cpp (2 cases: dispatch's magicmem pointer, guest_va_to_host's tv pointer via gettimeofday), both failed for the right reason against unmodified code.
GREEN: added SimpleMemory::base_for(addr) helper (simple_memory.hpp) picking region vs alias_region by containment; wired both broken call sites to it. Also fixed a missing #include <cstdint> in htif/command.hpp (pre-existing latent gap, blocked standalone testing). All 30 vsim_andesim unit tests pass (was 0 before my new test existed; new test now green, zero regressions).

Remaining: rebuild the real sim_ax66_makatau engine binary with the fix and re-run andesim's tests/vplat/test_vplat_gettimeofday.sh + vplat_file.elf against it to confirm the real end-to-end crash is gone (in progress, background build bpt56dugg). Then decide with user whether to commit (both repos currently have uncommitted changes; user's CLAUDE.md says never commit unless asked).
activeForm: Rebuilding ax66_makatau engine to confirm end-to-end fix
